answer_1.quote: We propose a novel Competencebased Multimodal Curriculum Learning framework (CMCL) which progressively learns medical reports following an easy-to-hard fashion.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the widely-used BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE-L, which are reported by the evaluation toolkit, to test the performance.

answer_4.quote: We invite two professional clinicians to evaluate the perceptual quality of 100 randomly selected reports generated by 'Baselines' and 'Baselines w/ CMCL'. All invited professional clinicians found that our approach can generate fluent reports with more accurate descriptions of abnormalities.
answer_4.guideline: Clinicians compared baseline and CMCL-generated reports and assessed fluency, accuracy of abnormal descriptions, and overall clinical usefulness.
